description: Presidential Secretariate - Call out all the members of the Armed Forces for the maintenance of Public Order with effect from 22.12.2023
categorisation: This gazette content involves the invocation of powers under the Public Security Ordinance (a legal framework) to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. It constitutes a legal/regulatory action by the President under existing legislation, making it primarily about legal and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category.
